notes.title: Update Patch Notes – New Camera System, AI Improvements & More :3
notes.notes:
[h1]Hiya @everyone :3[/h1]

I’ve just pushed out a new update packed with gameplay improvements, fixes, and some visual tweaks – all based on testing, feedback, and my ongoing quest to make this game smoother, smarter, and more fun! 



[h2]What's New?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Camera Rotation & Zoom: The camera now smoothly rotates and zooms depending on the gameplay state – check it out!
[*] Smarter AI Movement: The AI now moves much more smoothly and realistically.
[*] Wall Collision Improvements: Ball collisions against walls are now more accurate and responsive.
[*] Fixed Startup Sound Bug: No more weird audio glitches when the game launches.
[*] Updated Level Selector Checkmark Icon: Slight visual tweak to make it cleaner and clearer.
[*] Level Progress Saves on Exit: Your progress is now saved automatically when leaving the game.
[*] Multiple Ball Spawn Bug Fixed: Fixed an issue where players could summon multiple balls at any time – no more ball chaos!
[*] AI Toggle Restrictions: AI can now only be enabled/disabled in the Main Menu, not mid-game.
[*] AI Ball Spawn Logic Improved: The AI now only spawns a ball when it's in the correct position – tactical and fair!
[/list]



[h2]Coming Soon:[/h2]

Achievements are still in the works and more features are planned for future updates – stay tuned!

If you're enjoying the game (or just curious!), feel free to join our Discord community.

[h3]Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/YrMkQepXTt]https://discord.gg/YrMkQepXTt[/url][/h3]

You can hang out, find people to play with, suggest features, report bugs, share feedback, or just chat about games.

[h3]Your feedback really helps shape the game – thank you for being part of this with me <3[/h3]
